rule_used: distinct k8s.job.name emitting 'config is: {' on crawl-worker / scan-worker, environment == production
query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $d.resource.attributes.environment == 'production' && ($l.subsystemname == 'crawl-worker' || $l.subsystemname == 'scan-worker') && $d.message ~ 'config is: {' | groupby $l.subsystemname aggregate approx_count_distinct($d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name']) as jobs
notes: Window 2026-09-27..10-27 (30 d), single query, approx_count_distinct. First week alone: 492 crawl / 818 scan. GT tickets in window: 5 technical (#3315 E3, #3340 A6, #3369 A1, #3420 A2, #3425 A4) + 5 non-technical.

rule_used: per crawl job: (403+405)/all document statuses >= 50%, >= 5 statuses (crawl-worker, production)
query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $l.subsystemname == 'crawl-worker' && $d.resource.attributes.environment == 'production' && $d.message ~ 'http status code is: ' | extract $d.message:string into $d.x using regexp(e=/status code is: (?<code>[0-9]+)/) | extract $d.context.url:string into $d.u using regexp(e=/https?:\/\/(?<host>[^\/:?#]+)/) | groupby $d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name']:string as job aggregate count() as n, sum(if($d.x.code:string == '403' || $d.x.code:string == '405', 1, 0)) as s403, sum(if($d.x.code:string == '429', 1, 0)) as s429, sum(if($d.x.code:string == '202', 1, 0)) as s202, any_value($d.u.host:string) as host | filter n >= 5 && (s403 * 2 >= n || s202 * 10 >= n * 3 || s429 * 10 >= n)
notes: 18 registrable domains: nvidia(5), mheducation(4), huntington(4), comcast/xfinity/runmytests(7), sky.de(4: www x2 on 10-01, business x2 10-14/10-18), environicsanalytics(4, 10-22/10-26), aavacations, dinersclub, uhc, pbs, pulsenetwork, xumo, mettle... #3369 sky.de (created 10-08) matched by www.sky.de jobs 36c7f402/74476ae4. environicsanalytics jobs fall under A1 although GT for #3420 is A2 (Cloudflare 403 indistinguishable) - counted under A2's ticket, not here. Tenant not available on worker logs. Crawl-worker only (scan-worker statuses not included). Tarpit variant (OPEN_PAGE_TIMEOUT share >= 80%, >= 20 OPT) adds 22 crawl jobs / 14 hosts (see D1 record) -> A1 total 62 jobs, 62 events/ticket.

rule_used: per crawl job: 202 share >= 30%, >= 5 statuses
query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $l.subsystemname == 'crawl-worker' && $d.resource.attributes.environment == 'production' && $d.message ~ 'http status code is: ' | extract $d.message:string into $d.x using regexp(e=/status code is: (?<code>[0-9]+)/) | extract $d.context.url:string into $d.u using regexp(e=/https?:\/\/(?<host>[^\/:?#]+)/) | groupby $d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name']:string as job aggregate count() as n, sum(if($d.x.code:string == '403' || $d.x.code:string == '405', 1, 0)) as s403, sum(if($d.x.code:string == '429', 1, 0)) as s429, sum(if($d.x.code:string == '202', 1, 0)) as s202, any_value($d.u.host:string) as host | filter n >= 5 && (s403 * 2 >= n || s202 * 10 >= n * 3 || s429 * 10 >= n)
notes: booking.com x3 (also 429-heavy), creditblog.capitalone.ca x2, resources.dinersclub.com, content.pulsenetwork.com, medicare.uhc.com, flights.booking.com. #3420 (community.environicsanalytics.com, GT A2/Cloudflare) does NOT match this rule: its 4 jobs are 4/7 x 403 -> caught by A1 rule. If credited to A2 via host: 4 jobs/1 ticket.

rule_used: per crawl job: 429 share >= 10%, >= 5 statuses
query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $l.subsystemname == 'crawl-worker' && $d.resource.attributes.environment == 'production' && $d.message ~ 'http status code is: ' | extract $d.message:string into $d.x using regexp(e=/status code is: (?<code>[0-9]+)/) | extract $d.context.url:string into $d.u using regexp(e=/https?:\/\/(?<host>[^\/:?#]+)/) | groupby $d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name']:string as job aggregate count() as n, sum(if($d.x.code:string == '403' || $d.x.code:string == '405', 1, 0)) as s403, sum(if($d.x.code:string == '429', 1, 0)) as s429, sum(if($d.x.code:string == '202', 1, 0)) as s202, any_value($d.u.host:string) as host | filter n >= 5 && (s403 * 2 >= n || s202 * 10 >= n * 3 || s429 * 10 >= n)
notes: 12 domains; collegeboard subdomains 22 jobs (one tenant), booking.com 5, NatWest-group (natwest, rbs, ulsterbank, lombard, coutts) 5, lufthansagroup 2, sphere-media, hellomongoose, expedia careers, protexxa. No A5 ticket in window. Overlaps A2 on booking.com (3 jobs).

rule_used: per job: OPEN_PAGE_TIMEOUT failures >= 3 and OPT/(OPT+200) <= 10% (crawl-worker + scan-worker)
query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && ($l.subsystemname == 'crawl-worker' || $l.subsystemname == 'scan-worker') && $d.resource.attributes.environment == 'production' && ($d.message ~ 'failed due to OPEN_PAGE_TIMEOUT' || $d.message ~ 'http status code is: 200') | extract $d.context.url:string into $d.u using regexp(e=/https?:\/\/(?<host>[^\/:?#]+)/) | groupby $l.subsystemname as sub, $d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name']:string as job aggregate sum(if($d.message ~ 'OPEN_PAGE_TIMEOUT', 1, 0)) as opt, sum(if($d.message ~ 'is: 200', 1, 0)) as ok, any_value($d.u.host:string) as host | filter opt > 0 | create share from opt / (opt + ok) | create c from if(opt >= 3 && share <= 0.1, 'D1', if(share >= 0.8 && opt >= 20, 'A1_tarpit', if(opt >= 3, 'mid', 'lt3'))) | groupby c, sub, host aggregate count() as jobs
notes: Top hosts: verizon.com 6 (scan), tesco 7, moo 5, bellmedia 4, rds.ca 4, skysports 4, totalwine (www/qa/uat) 5, napoleonsports 3. 'Same URLs fail on every run' part of rule NOT applied (would need per-URL cross-run join) -> upper bound. No D1 ticket in window. Same query yields A1-tarpit (share >= 80%, >= 20 OPT): 22 crawl jobs / 14 hosts (bellmedia 4, ynet 5, superbet.gr 2, cp24 2, aa.com, tsn, capitalone.com...). 'mid' band (10-80%, ambiguous A1/A5/D1) not counted.

event_unit: property-day with chain-stop pair (one failed scheduled run)
rule_used: admin/front: 'Failing URL set .. due to job timeout/failure' + 'Failed running create crawl request' grouped by property_id x day (always 1:1 pairs)
query: source logs | filter ($l.subsystemname == 'admin-server' || $l.subsystemname == 'front-server') && ($d.message ~ 'Failing URL set' || $d.message ~ 'Failed running create crawl request') | groupby $d.context.tenant_name:string as tenant, $d.context.property_id:string as prop, formatTimestamp($m.timestamp, '%m-%d') as day aggregate count() as n | groupby tenant aggregate count() as events, distinct_count(prop) as props
notes: Comcast 36 props all on 10-04 (one burst -> E1-like), Capital One Exclusive 35, capitalone-sdk-testing 19, Sky UK 17, Charter 11, bell media 10, Optum 9, Maximus 7; weekly repeaters (Salesforce ad1a66c4b94e, Sky UK c0c02d8c5ac7, Evinced Dev, Progressive, Zalando, Cigna a60ce89ca410, Deloitte 504d3318fa02). #3315 (DU North, property ..6ef0321eaa54 / re-created ..640c955cf3cc) is NOT caught by this rule: those properties have no chain-stop pair. #3315 instead shows as scrape-server 'scan <id> succeed: scan url status 0 successful, urls and 12 failed urls' + 'Scan .. RUNNING to FAILED' on 09-28 (all pages failed). Alt rule E3b (scan with 0 successful and >0 failed URLs): 56 scans, 36 properties, 15 tenants in window (General Mills 14, Evinced Dev 10, Zalando 5, Kiddom 5, Total Wine 5, Capital One 3, Deloitte 2 = #3315) -> 56 events / 1 ticket. Deloitte's other property 504d3318fa02 fails the chain weekly (4 events) without a ticket.

alt_rule.rule: scrape-server 'scan url status 0 successful' with >0 failed urls (scan where every page failed)
alt_rule.query: source logs | filter $l.subsystemname == 'scrape-server' && $d.message ~ 'scan url status 0 successful' && !($d.message ~ 'and 0 failed') | extract $d.message:string into $d.s using regexp(e=/scan (?<sid>[0-9a-f-]{36}) succeed: scan url status 0 successful, urls and (?<f>\d+) failed/) | groupby $d.context.tenant_name:string as tenant aggregate approx_count_distinct($d.s.sid) as scans, distinct_count($d.context.property_id) as props

rule_used: crawl job on a node pool NOT named *pool-stat* (= useStaticIp=false) AND blocked (here: every such job had OPEN_PAGE_TIMEOUT on 100% of requests, zero 200s)
query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $l.subsystemname == 'crawl-worker' && $d.resource.attributes.environment == 'production' && !($d.resource.attributes['k8s.node.name']:string ~ 'pool-stat') && ($d.message ~ 'http status code is: ' || $d.message ~ 'failed due to OPEN_PAGE_TIMEOUT') | extract $d.message:string into $d.x using regexp(e=/status code is: (?<code>[0-9]+)/) | extract $d.context.url:string into $d.u using regexp(e=/https?:\/\/(?<host>[^\/:?#]+)/) | groupby $d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name']:string as job aggregate count() as n, sum(if($d.x.code:string == '403' || $d.x.code:string == '405', 1, 0)) as s403, sum(if($d.message ~ 'OPEN_PAGE_TIMEOUT', 1, 0)) as opt, any_value($d.u.host:string) as host
notes: All 22 non-static-pool crawl jobs in the window failed 100% with OPEN_PAGE_TIMEOUT (vs 94/1183 blocked on static pools). bell media 12 jobs (www.bellmedia.ca x4, rds.ca x4, tsn.ca, ctvnews.ca, noovomoi.ca, account.bellmedia.ca) -> #3425 Bell (fast-tier non-static IPs); Salesforce 6 (salesforce.com, tableau.com x3, trailhead); State of CT 4 (chfa.org x2, ctvisit pantheonsite x2). Admin 'Sending POST request' bodies: 205 useStaticIp=false requests / 137 properties / 5 tenants in window (State of CT 153, Salesforce 27, bell media 14, Superbets 10, Cigna 1) - most State of CT/Superbets requests left no non-static crawl-worker job (scans not checked). Job id in request body == k8s job name (verified on rds.ca 8ce83258). Tenant from admin-server context.

rule_used: crawl job whose config dump --user-agent is Chrome/65 or HeadlessChrome/65 AND blocked (<50% of status+failed-due-to lines are 200)
query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $l.subsystemname == 'crawl-worker' && $d.resource.attributes.environment == 'production' && ($d.message ~ 'http status code is: ' || $d.message ~ 'failed due to' || $d.message ~ 'config is: {') | extract $d.message:string into $d.x using regexp(e=/status code is: (?<code>[0-9]+)/) | extract $d.message:string into $d.ua using regexp(e=/--user-agent=[^"]*?(?<v>HeadlessChrome\/[0-9]+|Chrome\/[0-9]+)/) | groupby $d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name']:string as job aggregate count_if($d.message ~ 'status code is') as n, count_if($d.x.code:string == '200') as ok, count_if($d.message ~ 'failed due to') as fd, any_value($d.ua.v:string) as ua | create old from if(ua == 'Chrome/65' || ua ~ 'HeadlessChrome', 'old', 'current') | create blocked from if((n + fd) >= 1 && ok * 2 < (n + fd), 1, 0) | groupby old, blocked aggregate count() as jobs
notes: Grade partial. Old-UA jobs: 251 (50 blocked = 20%); current-UA jobs: 1099 (217 blocked = 20%) -> old UA shows NO excess block rate in this window, so the rule is weak. Blocked old-UA jobs concentrate in Capital One family (investor.capitalone.com x2 = #3340, capitalone.com, filetransfer, thecapitalonelab, autonav...), collegeboard (13), Salesforce/heroku/tableau (11), Discover. Tenant not on worker logs.

rule_used: crawl job with >=1 'final url not included in whitelist' and 0-1 visited ('successfully visited: N urls' summary), seed final-URL host NOT contained in the 'allowed domains: {..}' line
query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $d.resource.attributes.environment == 'production' && $l.subsystemname == 'crawl-worker' && ($d.message ~ 'allowed domains' || $d.message ~ 'final url not included in whitelist' || $d.message ~ 'successfully visited: ' || $d.message ~ 'final url after redirections') | extract $d.message:string into $d.f using regexp(e=/redirections: https?:\/\/(?:www\.)?(?<host>[^\/:?#\s]+)/) | extract $d.context.url:string into $d.u using regexp(e=/https?:\/\/(?:www\.)?(?<host>[^\/:?#]+)/) | extract $d.message:string into $d.s using regexp(e=/^successfully visited: (?<n>\d+) urls/) | groupby $d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name']:string as job aggregate any_value(if($d.message ~ 'allowed domains', $d.message:string, null)) as allowed, min(if($d.message ~ 'redirections', $d.f.host:string, null)) as fhost, any_value($d.u.host:string) as seedhost, count_if($d.message ~ 'whitelist') as wl, max($d.s.n:number) as visited | filter wl > 0 && (visited == null || visited <= 1) | create c from if(fhost == null || allowed == null, 'unknown', if(allowed.contains(fhost), 'C1_in', 'C2_out')) | groupby c aggregate count() as jobs, approx_count_distinct(seedhost) as hosts
notes: Top: <state>.comcast.com -> corporate.comcast.com 17 jobs/17 seeds (one config pattern), mybell -> identification.bell.ca 8, capitalone family 10+, ccbtcolumbus -> optumbhcare 6, sapsf -> login.microsoftonline.com 4, superbet.bet.br -> gov.br 4. ~14 jobs redirect to an IdP/login host (identification.bell.ca, login.microsoftonline.com, healthsafe-id) -> per discovery R4 those are B4/B5, not C2; strict C2 ~71. No C2 ticket in window. 'contains' is a substring test on the allowed list (subdomain semantics unverified). 37 distinct final hosts.

rule_used: same as C2 but the seed final-URL host IS in 'allowed domains' (include regex / path / locale rejected the seed)
query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $d.resource.attributes.environment == 'production' && $l.subsystemname == 'crawl-worker' && ($d.message ~ 'allowed domains' || $d.message ~ 'final url not included in whitelist' || $d.message ~ 'successfully visited: ' || $d.message ~ 'final url after redirections') | extract $d.message:string into $d.f using regexp(e=/redirections: https?:\/\/(?:www\.)?(?<host>[^\/:?#\s]+)/) | extract $d.context.url:string into $d.u using regexp(e=/https?:\/\/(?:www\.)?(?<host>[^\/:?#]+)/) | extract $d.message:string into $d.s using regexp(e=/^successfully visited: (?<n>\d+) urls/) | groupby $d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name']:string as job aggregate any_value(if($d.message ~ 'allowed domains', $d.message:string, null)) as allowed, min(if($d.message ~ 'redirections', $d.f.host:string, null)) as fhost, any_value($d.u.host:string) as seedhost, count_if($d.message ~ 'whitelist') as wl, max($d.s.n:number) as visited | filter wl > 0 && (visited == null || visited <= 1) | create c from if(fhost == null || allowed == null, 'unknown', if(allowed.contains(fhost), 'C1_in', 'C2_out')) | groupby c aggregate count() as jobs, approx_count_distinct(seedhost) as hosts
notes: stg.xfinity.com 5, satsuite.collegeboard 4, capitalone.com 4 (+autorefi, apply 4), discover.com 4, xfinity speedtest 3, wowtv.de 3 (wowtv /unavailable = A7 per R5 exception), healthcare4mi, williamsinn, bluemovie. 'language is not included in whitelist' variant not counted separately. No C1 ticket in window.

rule_used: interaction error 'No element found for selector' (or 'is not a valid selector') whose error.url (browser location) is a login/IdP page; 403/405-on-login-request exclusion NOT applied
query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $d.resource.attributes.environment == 'production' && ($l.subsystemname == 'crawl-worker' || $l.subsystemname == 'scan-worker') && $d.message ~ 'encountered error while running a function with timeout' && ($d.error.message:string ~ 'No element found for selector' || $d.error.message:string ~ 'is not a valid selector') | extract $d.error.message:string into $d.ej using jsonobject() | extract $d.ej.url:string into $d.b using regexp(e=/^(?<base>https?:\/\/[^?#]+)/) | create loginish from if($d.b.base:string.matches(/(?i)(login|signin|sign-in|logon|auth|sso|account|identifier|\/u\/|\/\/id\.|\/\/accounts\.)/), 1, 0) | groupby $l.subsystemname as sub, $d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name']:string as job aggregate max(loginish) as login, count_if($d.error.message:string ~ 'not a valid selector') as malformed | groupby sub, login aggregate count() as jobs
notes: accounts.zalando.com 10, id.spectrum.net 8, app.kiddom.co 5, toolservice.sky.it 4, identification.bell.ca 3, snr.bell.ca 3, community.environicsanalytics.com 3 (GT #3420 = A2: shows the A1/A2 block also surfaces as a selector failure, counted here as a B2 false positive), astraloutofhome 2, evernorth, bell.jasperwireless, bell.myprepaidcenter. 1 malformed-selector job. Selector failures with a non-login browser URL: 19 jobs (cigna demo 4, ulta, chick-fil-a, sky.de, spectrum business...) -> A7/B4/C4 candidates, not counted. No B2 ticket in window.

rule_used: PROXY: B2-style selector failure whose browser URL is an identity-provider host (accounts.*, id.*, identification.*, *.login.*) = identifier-first flow candidates
query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $d.resource.attributes.environment == 'production' && ($l.subsystemname == 'crawl-worker' || $l.subsystemname == 'scan-worker') && $d.message ~ 'encountered error while running a function with timeout' && ($d.error.message:string ~ 'No element found for selector' || $d.error.message:string ~ 'is not a valid selector') | extract $d.error.message:string into $d.ej using jsonobject() | extract $d.ej.url:string into $d.b using regexp(e=/^(?<base>https?:\/\/[^?#]+)/) | create loginish from if($d.b.base:string.matches(/(?i)(login|signin|sign-in|logon|auth|sso|account|identifier|\/u\/|\/\/id\.|\/\/accounts\.)/), 1, 0) | groupby $l.subsystemname as sub, $d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name']:string as job aggregate max(loginish) as login, count_if($d.error.message:string ~ 'not a valid selector') as malformed | groupby sub, login aggregate count() as jobs
notes: Partial grade: subset of the B2 events (accounts.zalando.com 10, id.spectrum.net 8, identification.bell.ca 3, p.universal.login.evernorth.com 1); the 'username typed then Continue fails' step-sequence check (login R4) was not run per job. Upper bound; overlaps B2. No ticket in window.

rule_used: per request: interaction started, submit clicked, no non-login final URL, still on login path; job = >=1 such 'stuck' request and NO request with login OK
query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $d.resource.attributes.environment == 'production' && ($l.subsystemname == 'crawl-worker' || $l.subsystemname == 'scan-worker') && ($d.message ~ 'final url after redirections' || $d.message ~ 'starting page interaction plugin' || $d.message ~ 'clicking element' || $d.message ~ 'No element found for selector') | extract $d.message into $d.fu using regexp(e=/redirections: (?<u>https?:\/\/[^?#\s]+)/) | create lg1 from if($d.message ~ 'final url' && $d.fu.u:string.matches(/(?i)(login|signin|sign-in|logon|authenticate|\/sso|\/guest$|\/auth\/)/), 1, 0) | create mfa1 from if($d.message ~ 'final url' && $d.fu.u:string.matches(/(?i)(mfa|otp|2fa|two-?factor|verify|verification|challenge|step-?up|passcode)/), 1, 0) | create nm1 from if($d.message ~ 'final url' && lg1 == 0, 1, 0) | create st1 from if($d.message ~ 'starting page', 1, 0) | create ck1 from if($d.message ~ 'clicking element', 1, 0) | create nf1 from if($d.message ~ 'No element found', 1, 0) | groupby $d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name']:string as job, $d.resource.attributes['k8s.pod.name']:string as pod, $d.context.request_id as rid aggregate sum(lg1) as lg, sum(nm1) as nm, sum(st1) as st, sum(ck1) as ck, sum(nf1) as nf, sum(mfa1) as mfa | create cls from if(st > 0 && nf > 0, 'selector_fail', if(st > 0 && ck > 0 && nm == 0 && lg > 0, 'stuck', if(st > 0 && ck > 0 && mfa > 0, 'mfa', if(st > 0 && nm > 0, 'login_ok', if(st == 0 && lg > 0, 'bounce', 'other'))))) | groupby job aggregate count_if(cls == 'stuck') as stuck, count_if(cls == 'login_ok') as ok, count_if(cls == 'mfa') as mfa, count_if(cls == 'bounce') as bounce, approx_count_distinct(if(cls == 'bounce', pod, null)) as bounce_pods, approx_count_distinct(pod) as pods | filter stuck > 0 || mfa > 0 || (ok > 0 && bounce >= 3) | create c from if(mfa > 0, 'B1', if(stuck > 0 && ok == 0, 'B3', if(ok > 0 && bounce >= 3 && bounce_pods < pods, 'B5', 'mixed'))) | groupby c aggregate count() as jobs
notes: account.bellmedia.ca 4, businessportal.bell.ca 3 (www + app1), wowtv.de 2, dns-email.twcbc.com 2, dealernavigator 1. 'Same ~20 s later on every request' timing check not applied. 35 further jobs are 'mixed' (stuck + ok requests: snr.bell.ca 9, ulta 5, vistaprint 4, environicsanalytics 4, ...) - not counted. No ticket in window.

rule_used: job with >=1 login-OK request and >=3 later login-path landings without interaction ('bounce'), bounces confined to a subset of pods
query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $d.resource.attributes.environment == 'production' && ($l.subsystemname == 'crawl-worker' || $l.subsystemname == 'scan-worker') && ($d.message ~ 'final url after redirections' || $d.message ~ 'starting page interaction plugin' || $d.message ~ 'clicking element' || $d.message ~ 'No element found for selector') | extract $d.message into $d.fu using regexp(e=/redirections: (?<u>https?:\/\/[^?#\s]+)/) | create lg1 from if($d.message ~ 'final url' && $d.fu.u:string.matches(/(?i)(login|signin|sign-in|logon|authenticate|\/sso|\/guest$|\/auth\/)/), 1, 0) | create mfa1 from if($d.message ~ 'final url' && $d.fu.u:string.matches(/(?i)(mfa|otp|2fa|two-?factor|verify|verification|challenge|step-?up|passcode)/), 1, 0) | create nm1 from if($d.message ~ 'final url' && lg1 == 0, 1, 0) | create st1 from if($d.message ~ 'starting page', 1, 0) | create ck1 from if($d.message ~ 'clicking element', 1, 0) | create nf1 from if($d.message ~ 'No element found', 1, 0) | groupby $d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name']:string as job, $d.resource.attributes['k8s.pod.name']:string as pod, $d.context.request_id as rid aggregate sum(lg1) as lg, sum(nm1) as nm, sum(st1) as st, sum(ck1) as ck, sum(nf1) as nf, sum(mfa1) as mfa | create cls from if(st > 0 && nf > 0, 'selector_fail', if(st > 0 && ck > 0 && nm == 0 && lg > 0, 'stuck', if(st > 0 && ck > 0 && mfa > 0, 'mfa', if(st > 0 && nm > 0, 'login_ok', if(st == 0 && lg > 0, 'bounce', 'other'))))) | groupby job aggregate count_if(cls == 'stuck') as stuck, count_if(cls == 'login_ok') as ok, count_if(cls == 'mfa') as mfa, count_if(cls == 'bounce') as bounce, approx_count_distinct(if(cls == 'bounce', pod, null)) as bounce_pods, approx_count_distinct(pod) as pods | filter stuck > 0 || mfa > 0 || (ok > 0 && bounce >= 3) | create c from if(mfa > 0, 'B1', if(stuck > 0 && ok == 0, 'B3', if(ok > 0 && bounce >= 3 && bounce_pods < pods, 'B5', 'mixed'))) | groupby c aggregate count() as jobs
notes: vistaprint 4, chkout-my.cigna.com 2, community.spectrum.net 1, demo.app.evernorth.com 1. Sticky-per-pod ordering (first OK then stays on login) not verified per pod; gated-page bounces (C4) can satisfy this rule. No ticket in window.

rule_used: interaction request that clicked submit and ended on a path with mfa|otp|2fa|verify|challenge|step-up|passcode
query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $d.resource.attributes.environment == 'production' && ($l.subsystemname == 'crawl-worker' || $l.subsystemname == 'scan-worker') && ($d.message ~ 'final url after redirections' || $d.message ~ 'starting page interaction plugin' || $d.message ~ 'clicking element' || $d.message ~ 'No element found for selector') | extract $d.message into $d.fu using regexp(e=/redirections: (?<u>https?:\/\/[^?#\s]+)/) | create lg1 from if($d.message ~ 'final url' && $d.fu.u:string.matches(/(?i)(login|signin|sign-in|logon|authenticate|\/sso|\/guest$|\/auth\/)/), 1, 0) | create mfa1 from if($d.message ~ 'final url' && $d.fu.u:string.matches(/(?i)(mfa|otp|2fa|two-?factor|verify|verification|challenge|step-?up|passcode)/), 1, 0) | create nm1 from if($d.message ~ 'final url' && lg1 == 0, 1, 0) | create st1 from if($d.message ~ 'starting page', 1, 0) | create ck1 from if($d.message ~ 'clicking element', 1, 0) | create nf1 from if($d.message ~ 'No element found', 1, 0) | groupby $d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name']:string as job, $d.resource.attributes['k8s.pod.name']:string as pod, $d.context.request_id as rid aggregate sum(lg1) as lg, sum(nm1) as nm, sum(st1) as st, sum(ck1) as ck, sum(nf1) as nf, sum(mfa1) as mfa | create cls from if(st > 0 && nf > 0, 'selector_fail', if(st > 0 && ck > 0 && nm == 0 && lg > 0, 'stuck', if(st > 0 && ck > 0 && mfa > 0, 'mfa', if(st > 0 && nm > 0, 'login_ok', if(st == 0 && lg > 0, 'bounce', 'other'))))) | groupby job aggregate count_if(cls == 'stuck') as stuck, count_if(cls == 'login_ok') as ok, count_if(cls == 'mfa') as mfa, count_if(cls == 'bounce') as bounce, approx_count_distinct(if(cls == 'bounce', pod, null)) as bounce_pods, approx_count_distinct(pod) as pods | filter stuck > 0 || mfa > 0 || (ok > 0 && bounce >= 3) | create c from if(mfa > 0, 'B1', if(stuck > 0 && ok == 0, 'B3', if(ok > 0 && bounce >= 3 && bounce_pods < pods, 'B5', 'mixed'))) | groupby c aggregate count() as jobs
notes: mybell.bell.ca 5, chick-fil-a 1. Not manually verified as MFA (path regex includes 'verify'; earlier 7-day research found 0 true cases) -> treat as candidates. No ticket in window.

event_unit: property (stuck schedule: same JobEntity key repeating)
rule_used: duplicate key (ids, run-at) JobEntity already exists repeating >= 10 times or over >= 20 min
query: source logs | filter ($l.applicationname == 'admin' || $l.applicationname == 'front') && $d.message ~ 'JobEntity) already exists' | extract $d.message into $d.dk using regexp(e=/=\((?<ids>[0-9a-f-]{72})(?<runat>\d{4}-\d\d-\d\dT\d\d:\d\d), JobEntity/) | groupby $d.dk.ids:string as ids, $d.dk.runat:string as runat aggregate count() as n, min($m.timestamp) as first, max($m.timestamp) as last | create mins from (last - first) / 1m | filter mins >= 20 || n >= 10
notes: Background: ~2,000 (key, run-at) pairs across ~30 tenants each log the duplicate 2-4 times within < 1 min at the scheduled tick (benign insert race, max span 0.7 min) - must NOT be counted. No stuck-schedule (repeating every ~7.5 min) case in the window. No E2 ticket.

rule_used: 'failed to create entity for property' with error.type LimitExceededException ('The license has expired')
query: source logs | filter ($l.applicationname == 'admin' || $l.applicationname == 'front') && $d.message ~ 'failed to create entity for property' && !($d.error.message:string ~ 'No URLs were supplied') | groupby $d.error.type:string as et, substr($d.error.message:string,0,40) as em, $d.context.tenant_name:string as tenant aggregate count() as n, distinct_count($d.context.property_id) as props, min($m.timestamp) as first
notes: ~427k log lines (logged every scheduler tick). Shopify 11 props, Stepstone 5 (new 10-03), BB Pilates 5, Hartford 3, Fiserv 2, State of CT 2 (new 10-01), Fanatics, Hyundai, Coupa, NYC Gov, Warwick 1 each. 9 of 11 tenants were already failing at window start (chronic expired licences). No E4 ticket in window.

rule_used: 'failed to create entity' with 'No URLs were supplied' / 'URL set not defined' / 'Scan must have at least one URL'
query: source logs | filter ($l.applicationname == 'admin' || $l.applicationname == 'front') && $d.message ~ 'failed to create entity for property' | create k from if($d.error.type:string ~ 'LimitExceeded', 'E4_limit', if($d.error.message:string ~ 'No URLs were supplied' || $d.error.message:string ~ 'URL set not defined' || $d.error.message:string ~ 'at least one URL', 'C7_nourls', 'other')) | groupby k aggregate count() as n, distinct_count($d.context.property_id) as props, distinct_count($d.context.tenant_name) as tenants
notes: 'No URLs were supplied' 11 props / 8 tenants (153k lines); 'Scan must have at least one URL' State of CT 2, NatWest 1, Capital One 1 (tenants approx; may overlap). 'max visits reached with visited = 1' (page cap = 1) variant not counted. Mostly chronic config. No C7 ticket in window.

rule_used: admin/front 'failed to generate CSV|XLSX for scan <id>' grouped by scan id; plus CSV queue publish errors and completion-email failures reported separately
query: source logs | filter ($l.applicationname == 'admin' || $l.applicationname == 'front' || $l.subsystemname == 'admin-webapp' || $l.subsystemname == 'front-webapp') && (matches($d.message:string, /failed to generate (CSV|XLSX)|Failed to send (crawl|scan) completion email/) || ($d.logger_name == 'c.e.p.c.s.c.CsvGenerationRabbitCommunicator' && $m.severity == ERROR)) | extract $d.message into $d.ex using regexp(e=/generate (?<fmt>CSV|XLSX) for scan (?<scan>[0-9a-f-]{36})/) | create kind from if($d.message ~ 'completion email', 'email', if($d.message ~ 'generate', 'export', 'publish')) | groupby kind aggregate count() as n, approx_count_distinct($d.ex.scan) as scans, distinct_count($d.context.tenant_name) as tenants
notes: 4,986 'failed to generate' lines over 99 scans (mostly poller timeout); tenant_name present on few lines (4 tenants seen = lower bound). Also: 103 CSV queue publish failures, 369 crawl completion-email failures (1 tenant). front-server ProductExportController/Service.checkReportExists long-polls > 10 s ~271k calls (1 tenant) - export waiting, part of the F1 picture. No F1 ticket in window.

event_unit: slow API call group (tenant x function x hour) with a front-server call > 10 s
rule_used: FunctionLogger 'invocation of function (X) took N millis' with N > 10000, excluding checkReportExists (export long-poll) and TokenController; grouped tenant x fn x hour
query: source logs | filter $l.subsystemname == 'front-server' && $d.logger_name == 'c.e.c.l.f.FunctionLogger' && $d.message ~ 'took' && !($d.message ~ 'checkReportExists') && !($d.message ~ 'TokenController') | extract $d.message into $d.fx using regexp(e=/\((?<fn>[A-Za-z]+\.[A-Za-z]+)\) (?<what>took|failed)/) | extract $d.message into $d.fm using regexp(e=/(?<ms>[0-9]+) millis/) | filter $d.fm.ms:number > 10000 | groupby formatTimestamp($m.timestamp, '%m-%d %H') as hr, $d.context.tenant_name:string as tenant, $d.fx.fn:string as fn aggregate count() as calls | groupby true aggregate count() as groups, sum(calls) as calls, distinct_count(tenant) as tenants
notes: 2,224 slow calls in 198 distinct hours. Top: ScanComponentsController.list 739 calls, ScanPagesController.list 381, PropertyOverviewController.list 173 (17 tenants, max 118 s), ScanIssuesController.list, ScanController.list (max 55 s), exportResultsCsv (max 755 s). The join to a 5xx RestExceptionHandler line by operation_id was NOT applied (gateway 502/504 not logged), so this counts slowness, not confirmed user-visible failures -> upper bound. NotFound-deleted-scan variant: 0 matched with this regex. No E5 ticket in window.

rule_used: hour with >= 5 distinct tenants logging FAILED / dispatch-failure / scan-timeout / HikariPool lines (admin-server + front-server)
query: source logs | filter ($l.subsystemname == 'admin-server' || $l.subsystemname == 'front-server') && ($d.message:string.matches(/state changed from \w+ to FAILED/) || $d.message ~ 'changed state to: FAILED' || $d.message ~ 'Failed running create crawl request' || $d.message ~ 'passed its timeout, marking it as FAILED' || $d.message ~ 'HikariPool') | extract $d.message into $d.mdc using regexp(e=/tenancyName=(?<tenant>[^\]]+)\]/) | groupby roundTime($m.timestamp, 1h) as hour aggregate count() as n, distinct_count(firstNonNull($d.context.tenant_name:string, $d.mdc.tenant:string)) as tenants
notes: 180 hours had any such line; max 3 tenants/hour (3 hours at 3-4 tenants). No platform incident in window and no E1 ticket. The Comcast burst of 36 chain-stops on 10-04 is single-tenant (counted under E3). Worker-volume-collapse variant not checked.

rule_used: '<KIND> with id .. failed due to FAILED_TO_RUN_ENGINES' (scan-worker)
query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $d.resource.attributes.environment == 'production' && ($l.subsystemname == 'crawl-worker' || $l.subsystemname == 'scan-worker') && ($d.message ~ 'failed due to FAILED_TO_RUN_ENGINES' || $d.message ~ 'failed due to DNS_ERROR' || $d.message ~ 'ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS' || $d.message ~ 'ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED') && !($d.message ~ '[browser]') | extract $d.context.url:string into $d.u using regexp(e=/https?:\/\/(?<host>[^\/:?#]+)/) | create k from if($d.message ~ 'FAILED_TO_RUN_ENGINES', 'D2', if($d.message ~ 'TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS', 'A8', 'C4_dns')) | groupby k, $l.subsystemname as sub, $d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name']:string as job aggregate count() as n, any_value($d.u.host:string) as host | groupby k, sub aggregate count() as jobs, approx_count_distinct(host) as hosts, sum(n) as lines
notes: 604 failing pages over 35 scan jobs / 12 hosts (e.g. rds.ca). Evinced-side ENGINES_PLUGIN_ERROR (ENOENT) not split off here (different text, not matched). No D2 ticket in window.

rule_used: job logging net::ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS (non-[browser] lines)
query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $d.resource.attributes.environment == 'production' && ($l.subsystemname == 'crawl-worker' || $l.subsystemname == 'scan-worker') && ($d.message ~ 'failed due to FAILED_TO_RUN_ENGINES' || $d.message ~ 'failed due to DNS_ERROR' || $d.message ~ 'ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS' || $d.message ~ 'ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED') && !($d.message ~ '[browser]') | extract $d.context.url:string into $d.u using regexp(e=/https?:\/\/(?<host>[^\/:?#]+)/) | create k from if($d.message ~ 'FAILED_TO_RUN_ENGINES', 'D2', if($d.message ~ 'TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS', 'A8', 'C4_dns')) | groupby k, $l.subsystemname as sub, $d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name']:string as job aggregate count() as n, any_value($d.u.host:string) as host | groupby k, sub aggregate count() as jobs, approx_count_distinct(host) as hosts, sum(n) as lines
notes: 184 lines; moo.com, verizon.com among hosts. Page-level, not restricted to the seed -> includes jobs where only a few pages loop. No A8 ticket in window.

rule_used: job logging 'failed due to DNS_ERROR_COULD_NOT_FIND_URL' or net::ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED (non-[browser])
query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $d.resource.attributes.environment == 'production' && ($l.subsystemname == 'crawl-worker' || $l.subsystemname == 'scan-worker') && ($d.message ~ 'failed due to FAILED_TO_RUN_ENGINES' || $d.message ~ 'failed due to DNS_ERROR' || $d.message ~ 'ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS' || $d.message ~ 'ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED') && !($d.message ~ '[browser]') | extract $d.context.url:string into $d.u using regexp(e=/https?:\/\/(?<host>[^\/:?#]+)/) | create k from if($d.message ~ 'FAILED_TO_RUN_ENGINES', 'D2', if($d.message ~ 'TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS', 'A8', 'C4_dns')) | groupby k, $l.subsystemname as sub, $d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name']:string as job aggregate count() as n, any_value($d.u.host:string) as host | groupby k, sub aggregate count() as jobs, approx_count_distinct(host) as hosts, sum(n) as lines
notes: Examples www-test.cignaglobal.com, prod.generalmills.com.gr. Not restricted to the seed, and the '404 share' / final '/404' variants of the C4 rule were not counted -> partial C4 coverage (DNS variant only), upper bound for that variant. No C4 ticket in window.

rule_used: final url after redirections (or interaction error.url) on an out-of-country / unavailable / geo-block path
query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $d.resource.attributes.environment == 'production' && ($l.subsystemname == 'crawl-worker' || $l.subsystemname == 'scan-worker') && ($d.message ~ 'final url after redirections' || $d.error.message:string ~ 'No element found for selector') && ($d.message:string.matches(/(?i)redirections: \S*(out-of-country|\/unavailable|geo-?block|not-available-in|region-?block)/) || $d.error.message:string.matches(/(?i)"url":"[^"]*(out-of-country|\/unavailable|geo-?block|region-?block)/)) | groupby $d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name']:string as job aggregate count() as n, any_value($d.context.url) as url
notes: help.sainsburys.co.uk 10 (1 line each - likely an 'unavailable' help article, false positive), wowtv.de 9, sky.de 6, sky.at 3, verizon 1, ctvnews 1. Sky DE/AT geo landings coexist with the sky.de 403 jobs of #3369 (GT A1) - not credited here. Strict (excluding sainsburys): 20 jobs / 6 hosts. No A7 ticket in window.

rule_used: crawl job with > 10,000 'not including url in result url set' rejects of which >= 90% are blacklist ('final url is included in')
query: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $d.resource.attributes.environment == 'production' && $l.subsystemname == 'crawl-worker' && $d.message ~ 'not including url in result url set' | groupby $d.resource.attributes['k8s.job.name']:string as job aggregate count() as rej, count_if($d.message ~ 'final url is included in') as bl | filter rej > 10000 | create c from if(bl * 10 >= rej * 9, 'C3', 'other') | groupby c aggregate count() as jobs, max(rej) as maxrej
notes: Max 91.5k rejects in one job. Blacklist reject lines carry no $d.context.url, so hosts not resolved (likely Salesforce 'All except docs' family per earlier research). 3 more >10k-reject jobs are dominated by other reasons (salesforce.com/jp). No C3 ticket in window.
